name: Life Saving Technique Water Sports Operator
benefit: The beneficiary will receive training as a Water Saving Life Trainer.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be able to swim 100 meters within 3 minutes. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy. > The total number of 15 beneficiaries will be selected.
